`WarningIcon` is defined in openmrs-esm-core and used directly in three places in the patient chart, all in the order-basket item tiles. Each of those tiles renders it as the error marker for an order that failed validation or submission, so a behaviour change would show up there.

**Direct consumers in openmrs-esm-patient-chart (best first):**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/drug-order-basket-panel/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`: imports `WarningIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework` (line 5) and renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` in the drug order error block (lines 87–96). This is the drug-order basket tile, and it is also the one with the richest extension-slot and dosage rendering around the error.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-orders/lab-order-basket-panel/lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`: imports it at line 5 and renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` in the lab order error block (lines 41–53). This is the lab test-order basket tile.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket/general-order-type/order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`: imports it at line 5 and renders `<WarningIcon size={16} />` in the general order error block (lines 33–45, component starts at line 15). This is the general-order basket tile.

**Framework definition (openmrs-esm-core), which the behaviour change would come from:**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/icons/icons.tsx` lines 848–852: `WarningIcon` is `memo(forwardRef(...))` wrapping `<Icon icon="omrs-icon-warning" />`. Line 859 defines `AllergiesIcon = WarningIcon`, so anything that uses `AllergiesIcon` would also be affected. I did not search the chart for `AllergiesIcon` usages, so that is unverified.

**Test mocks in openmrs-esm-core that would also change under a behaviour change:**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/mock.tsx` line 103 and `mock-jest.tsx` line 102: stub `WarningIcon` as a `<span>`. Chart tests that rely on these mocks would see the stub, not the real icon, so they would not catch a real icon change.

**Not checked:** I only searched for the literal `WarningIcon` name in the patient chart. I did not check whether the chart re-exports or wraps it, or whether any other repository (for example the other OpenMRS frontend apps) imports it. I did not look at version history either, so I cannot say what the actual change would have been.
